applicabilityBasis.summary: Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. issues fUSD as a U.S. dollar payment stablecoin backed 1:1 by cash, short-dated U.S. Treasuries, and Treasury-backed repo under its Covered Stablecoin Terms, redeemable at USD 1 for onboarded bank clients.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-11-27. Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. is an OCC-chartered uninsured national trust bank and announces fUSD as aligned with the GENIUS Act framework, supporting issuer-announced-intent on the federal-qualified-nonbank pathway rather than an existing token-specific PPSI approval. Covered Stablecoin Terms establish 1:1 USD redemption terms for onboarded bank clients. Although Anchorage's reserve transparency hub lists USDtb, USAT, USDPT, USDGO, and ZLUSD, no fUSD-specific reserve holdings page or independent examination report was published there as of November 27, 2026, so reserveDisclosurePresent and monthlyAttestationPresent are false. Treasury identifies January 18, 2027 as the expected Act effective date and July 18, 2028 for the general DASP offer/sale restriction. Falcon Finance operates as commercial distribution partner and separately from USDf.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-11-27, no fUSD-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, official GENIUS application acknowledgment, published reserve examination, or GENIUS enforcement action was located in these sources. Anchorage's existing national trust bank charter establishes federal bank supervision, not a separate GENIUS PPSI grant.
